steps.what: Show the stored interface between the drive and the vehicle.
Integrate electric drive subsystems to optimize performance or mitigate faults.

tasks.design: The {OPS_SYSTEM} shows the interface already stored between the electric drive and the other vehicle systems. The fuel cell engineer integrates the subsystems, works the performance, and mitigates the faults on the vehicle. The interface list does not clear a fault. A missing interface leaves the work with the engineer.
tasks.previous_blocker: A fault was marked cleared because the interface id existed, and the fault was still on the vehicle.
tasks.enabler_now: The stored interface can be opened. The integration and the fault work still happen on the vehicle.
tasks.still_hard: A fault the interface list does not name still has to be mitigated by the engineer.
tasks.human_edge: The engineer integrates the drive and mitigates the fault. The interface list does not clear it.
tasks.altitude: Integration and fault work stay on the vehicle. The stored interface is visible and is not the repair.

reach.task: Name the vehicle system the drive has to meet.
reach.learn: An interface id is not the integration.

evidence.claim: Opening a stored interface is a lookup. It does not integrate a drive or mitigate a fault.
Clearing a fault from an interface id alone would record a repair that has not been done.

assumptions: Workflow boundary: A fuel cell engineer in a mid-size European company. A stored record is not the experiment, and a draft is not the accepted design.

Fields: The interface id already stored between the drive and the named vehicle system. The screen does not mark a fault cleared. If a required field is missing, the step stops and the fuel cell engineer finishes it by hand.
Native check: Open the interface on the operations record before the vehicle work.
unknowns: Whether performance notes and fault notes share one interface record.
research_questions: Who confirms an interface id matches the vehicle now being worked on?

already_counted.description: Integrating the drive and mitigating faults stay with the engineer.

incremental.description: Drop interface rows whose vehicle record has been withdrawn.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: The engineer still integrates the electric drive with the other vehicle systems and still mitigates faults on the vehicle. Only opening an interface that was already stored is removed. An interface id saves none of that work, and it does not clear a fault.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Show the stored hydrogen storage method for this application.
Develop or evaluate hydrogen storage methods for cell applications.

tasks.design: The {DOCS} store shows the hydrogen storage method already recorded for this application. The fuel cell engineer develops or evaluates the method. The record does not decide whether the method is fit. Only the evaluation the engineer accepts is filed.
tasks.previous_blocker: A storage method was treated as accepted because a record existed, and nobody had evaluated it for this cell.
tasks.enabler_now: The stored method can be opened. The development and the evaluation still belong to the engineer.
tasks.still_hard: A storage risk the method record does not mention still has to be judged by the engineer.
tasks.human_edge: The engineer develops or evaluates the method. The record is not the evaluation.
tasks.altitude: Development and evaluation stay with the engineer. The file stores only the evaluation that engineer accepted.

reach.task: Read a storage evaluation the fuel cell engineer has accepted.
reach.learn: A method record is not a finding that the method is fit.

evidence.claim: Opening a stored storage method is a lookup. It does not develop or evaluate the method for a fuel cell application.
Filing an evaluation before the engineer accepts that version would store a fitness judgement nobody made.

assumptions: Workflow boundary: A fuel cell engineer in a mid-size European company. A stored record is not the experiment, and a draft is not the accepted design.

Fields: The method id and the application id already stored. The evaluation text is not added by the screen. If a required field is missing, the step stops and the fuel cell engineer finishes it by hand.
Native check: Open the method in the document store before the evaluation.
Any edit after approval voids the version and returns the item to the fuel cell engineer.
unknowns: Whether one method record covers every fuel cell application or only one.
research_questions: Who records a hydrogen storage method before an engineer evaluates it?

already_counted.description: Developing or evaluating the storage method stays with the engineer.

incremental.description: Drop method records whose application has been withdrawn.

approvals.approved_version: method id, application id, and the evaluation sentence the engineer accepted

time_saved_range_pct.basis: The engineer still develops or evaluates the hydrogen storage method for the fuel cell application. Only opening a method already recorded, and filing the evaluation already accepted, is removed. A method record saves none of that judgement.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: The fuel cell engineer still integrates the drive on the vehicle and still judges hydrogen storage. A stored interface can be opened. It does not clear a fault or approve a storage method.
reach: Vehicle technicians see the interface, and this job learns the list does not mitigate a fault.
Safety reviewers read an accepted storage evaluation, and this job learns a method record is not the evaluation.
skills_to_grow: Integrate the drive and mitigate faults on the vehicle, not from the interface list.
Develop or evaluate a hydrogen storage method on its own evidence.
role.ambitious_version: Drive integration and hydrogen storage judgement stay with the engineer. Stored interfaces and method records only show what was already written.
